reading.headline: Bank ledger against the statement: opening gap, closing gap and change in window not established (this file was parsed with a from or to date that leaves out part of the statement and is not a whole calendar month (from the 1st to a month's last day), and only whole months are compared; parse the statement again with whole months within its dates, or without from and to (a month the statement covers only in part is compared only as part of the whole statement)).
reading.scope: This checks the bank ledger only, and takes the ledger named in the file to be a bank account: an income or expense ledger opens at zero for the period, so its gaps would mean nothing. A wrong party or expense ledger is not caught here.
reading.stage: The closing figure counts this file's vouchers as if they were already in the book. Once any of them has been imported, use stage after_post.
